crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…
For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

translations.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
translations.bsb: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
translations.kjv: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
translations.asv: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.
